claimBoundary.acceptance: A case agrees only when every included projection channel matches exactly after the declared side-specific artifact normalization; missing or extra observations reject the case.
exclusions: proof of any future falsifier biting
claimBoundary.rejection: Any unresolved fixture reference, world drift, case reorder/addition/deletion, projection omission, unexpected deviation, or channel mismatch rejects the campaign.
claimBoundary.statement: Passing all rows demonstrates agreement only on this finite frozen corpus.

digest.scope: the entire parsed document with /campaign/digest/value replaced by the empty string

campaign.name: Lido OssifiableProxy frozen semantic differential corpus

sharedPerformanceManifest.importRule: Resolve every performance: symbolic reference through sharedReferenceBindings against this exact manifest; reject digest drift.

artifactBinding.creationTemplate: exact bytes emitted as creationTemplate by scripts/eval-lido-ossifiable-proxy-artifacts.lean
artifactBinding.fullCreateInput: creationTemplate concatenated with the case constructor argument suffix
artifactBinding.returnedRuntime: exact runtime returned by successful CREATE and emitted/pinned by the same evaluator

blanc.futureCandidateRule: The later result must pin exact evaluator-emitted artifact digests and the evaluated Blanc commit; this manifest does not invent unavailable candidate digests.

artifactBinding.fullCreateInput: locked creationTemplate bytes concatenated with the case constructor argument suffix

worldContract.artifactDifferenceOnly: Reference and Blanc sides use their own locked/evaluator-bound creationTemplate and returnedRuntime; every other world input is identical.

projectionContract.eth: Compare exact balance deltas for every manifest-declared account; exact-prestate means zero deltas.
projectionContract.logs: Resolve each expected log atom to exact emitting address, ordered topics, and data bytes; missing, extra, or reordered logs reject.
projectionContract.returndata: Exact bytes, except own-returned-runtime means each side's separately bound returnedRuntime artifact.
projectionContract.storage: Compare the two exact ERC-1967 slots, fixture-slot, target existence, and every explicitly named override; unmentioned observed words must equal the stated base/prestate.
projectionContract.targetAccount: Constructor success requires an account holding that side's bound returnedRuntime; constructor failure requires absence. Runtime calls require the preexisting proxy account.
excludedFields: raw equality between the two sides' distinct program bytecode

uac-length-over-u64.description: proxy__upgradeToAndCall(new-implementation, bytes@0x60 length=2^64, false) with no payload; exact runtime decoder Panic(0x41) arm

offset-oob.description: frozen ABI constructor argument suffix: offset-oob

set-implementation.description: SSTORE post-setup implementation into the ERC-1967 implementation slot, then return empty

set-admin.description: SSTORE new-admin into the ERC-1967 admin slot, then return empty

set-both.description: write both ERC-1967 slots, then return empty

set-both-revert.description: write both ERC-1967 slots, then revert with rollback-marker-32

stack-underflow.description: execute POP on an empty stack

emit-log.description: emit LOG1 from proxy context with the frozen topic and 32-byte data, then return empty

coverage.selectorArmRule: Each of the seven named selectors has at least one success and one negative case; constructor and fallback also have both arms.

reference-substitution.mutation: substitute either locked Solidity artifact, lock digest, compiler identity, or evaluator-bound Blanc artifact
reference-substitution.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must reject before accepting any semantic row under the substituted identity.

selector-routing.mutation: redirect a named selector, a 0-3 byte input, or the unknown selector to the wrong branch
selector-routing.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must observe a status/returndata/state/call-trace mismatch.

event-error-bytes.mutation: change one event topic/data/address/order byte or one custom/string error byte
event-error-bytes.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must reject the mutated exact log or returndata projection.

state-projection.mutation: drop, rename, or change either ERC-1967 slot, fixture slot, or target-account observation
state-projection.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must reject an incomplete or altered logical-state projection.

rollback.mutation: retain a rolled-back slot write, target account, log, ETH delta, or child effect
rollback.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must reject any non-prestate persisted effect.

child-call-observation.mutation: change, omit, insert, or reorder a DELEGATECALL field or row
child-call-observation.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must reject against the exact ordered delegatecall projection.

corpus-result-mutation.mutation: delete, insert, reorder, duplicate, edit, or relabel a corpus case, or later alter a result row/campaign binding
corpus-result-mutation.acceptanceBoundary: The future gate must pin this digest, fixed count, fixed order, unique IDs, and one later result row per ID, and reject every mutation.
